card.name: The word Reserve starting a sentence
card.fires_on: The word "Reserve" at the start of a sentence in opioid boxed-warning text. It follows a sentence ending in treatment goals or death and comes before "titration" or "concomitant prescribing".

modes.label: Reserve titration
modes.description: "Reserve" opens the sentence after the advice on lowest effective dosage and shortest duration.
modes.example: Use the lowest effective dosage for the shortest duration of time consistent with individual patient treatment goals.<< Reserve>> titration to higher doses of fentanyl

modes.label: Reserve concomitant prescribing
modes.description: "Reserve" opens the sentence right after the list of sedation, respiratory depression, coma and death risks.
modes.example: including alcohol, can increase the risk of hypotension, respiratory depression, profound sedation, coma, and death.<< Reserve>> concomitant prescribing of these drugs for

card.writes: The promoted tokens are mostly unrelated ("Personal", Chinese words), so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It lights up on the sentence-opening word "Reserve" in opioid warning boxes.
